name: Proud Husky 84
author: cohencoo
description: Rounded amber text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, background-color changes from #e2e2e2 to #fff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Proud Husky 84</title>
<style>
/* Proud Husky 84 by cohencoo — https://uiverse.io/cohencoo/proud-husky-84 */
.input {
  border-radius: 10px;
  outline: 2px solid #FEBF00;
  border: 0;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, 'Open Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
  background-color: #e2e2e2;
  outline-offset: 3px;
  padding: 10px 1rem;
  transition: 0.25s;
}

.input:focus {
  outline-offset: 5px;
  background-color: #fff
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input type="text" placeholder="Write here..." name="text" class="input">

</body>
</html>
